temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. When Maria offers help, Cheryl gratefully accepts and says she could definitely use it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria did not yet have a specific belief that Cheryl was struggling; she may have assumed Cheryl was managing her project responsibilities or had no clear view of Cheryl's current workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns that Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and open to receiving help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is stressed and overwhelmed by the project workload and would benefit from Maria's assistance; Cheryl welcomes Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. In a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl accepts, thanking Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl had been overwhelmed and that the help she provided had been useful, but she had not yet formed a firm belief about Cheryl's readiness for a leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria observes Cheryl's improved handling and growing confidence, then sees Cheryl accept the leadership role confidently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, committed, and ready to lead the next phase of the project; Maria's confidence in her is justified.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and moving the project forward.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to make sure she feels supported and not pressured. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and that it means a lot that Maria believes in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl was capable and had accepted the leadership role, but she worried that her suggestion may have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's response reassures Maria that she feels supported rather than pressured and values Maria's belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl does not resent Maria's suggestion or feel overstepped; she appreciates Maria's honesty and support, and their relationship remains trusting.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially anxious and concerned, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain trust with Cheryl by clarifying her intentions and continuing to support Cheryl's leadership.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together. Cheryl responds enthusiastically, calling it a fantastic idea and saying Maria's guidance has been invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl appreciated her honesty and support and that their relationship was positive, but she had not yet confirmed whether Cheryl wanted an equal collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's enthusiastic response shows she values Maria's guidance and wants to co-lead with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl welcomes a co-leading partnership; they can support each other effectively and work well as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and build a mutually supportive collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects, and Cheryl says she would love that, calling working with Maria wonderful and saying she is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed their collaboration had been fruitful and their partnership strengthened, and she hoped Cheryl would want to continue working together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms and strengthens Maria's belief that their partnership is valuable and has a strong future.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl have strong synergy, mutual appreciation, and a shared desire to continue collaborating on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more future projects and continue their successful collaboration.
